answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 13349 Country: MY Title: Assalamualaikum.....Dear Maulana Saheb...Now I am suffering an Insomnia.Can U provide me some amal so that I may spent my night with that amal? Question: Assalamualaikum.....Dear Maulana Saheb...Now I am suffering an Insomnia.Can U provide me some amal so that I may spent my night with that amal? Answer ID: 13349 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1244/1975=H/1430) Recite the durood read in salah 100 times before going to bed. Also, sleep at clean bed and adopt sunnah method of sleeping. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
